title: Figma Forecasts Up to $1.499B in 2026 Revenue Following Q3 Sales Beat
summary:
The design software firm reported third-quarter revenue of $391.4M, exceeding the $376M analyst estimate as sales climbed 43% from a year earlier. Adjusted earnings per share were $0.10, compared with an estimated $0.05, and non-GAAP operating income reached $47M, nearly double the $23.5M forecast.

Figma raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to between $1.497B and $1.499B, up from previous expectations of $1.47B, and increased its annual non-GAAP operating income outlook to a range of $158M to $163M. Despite the beats, shares fell as much as 7% in after-hours trading. The company noted that about 65% of customers with more than $10,000 in annual recurring revenue have adopted its new AI agent.
